## Links shared

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(glue)
fpath <- glue("{here::here()}/RLadiesRemote/2026-04-22/meeting_saved_new_chat.txt")
raw_data <- read_lines(fpath)
url_pattern <- "https?://\\S+"
urls <- regmatches(raw_data, gregexpr(url_pattern,  raw_data)) |> 
  unlist()
all_urls <- urls |> 
  tibble(url = _) |> 
  filter(!(row_number() %in% 1:4)) |> 
  mutate(url = str_remove(url, "\":")) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  filter(!str_detect(url, "\\.\\.\\.")) |> 
  mutate(url_text = str_remove(url, "https://"),
         url_text = str_remove(url_text, "/$"))
```

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| output: asis
for (i in 1:nrow(all_urls)) {
  output <- glue("* [{all_urls$url_text[i]}]({all_urls$url[i]})\n\n")
  cat(output)
}
```
